reasoning: The question asks whether the EM HY corporate spread will increase from Oct 11 to Oct 18, 2026. Evidence shows significant market stress in late Sept/early Oct 2026: US Treasury yields hit 5.36% (20-year high), Fed raised rates to 3.75-4.00%, and corporate bond yields rose sharply (US HY yields jumped 107bp to 8.35% in Sept). However, snippet 10 indicates spreads were narrowing between June-Sept 2026 (9bp reduction in HY). The recent bond selloff (Oct 7-8) suggests renewed pressure, but EM sovereign bond ETF rose 0.3% on Oct 9. Given the volatile environment with competing forces (recent stress vs prior narrowing trend), and that weekly spread movements are inherently uncertain, I estimate roughly even odds with slight bias toward increase given recent stress.
